generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portrait master, to be reduced to 58x64 and a face crop 48x32 pixels. Subject: Sett from League of Legends, recognizable adult muscular male vastaya brawler, short tousled burgundy hair with two small furry pointed animal ears, strong jaw and a small facial scar, amber eyes, dark red open coat with thick cream fur collar and gold accents, confident smirk. Background richly textured muted purple and warm orange tavern paint. Close compact head-and-shoulders portrait, entire hair/hat silhouette within frame, face large and readable, three-quarter view. Painterly late-1990s fantasy game portrait, textured hand-painted oil miniature, natural anatomy and individual facial planes, strong warm light from upper left, crisp readable eyes and silhouette, restrained metallic highlights. Original composition, not a copy of a splash painting. No anime, no chibi, no glossy modern key art, no photoreal photograph, no typography, no border, no watermark. One character only, square composition.
